messages:
zoe: follow-up from the "tenant routing" RFC meeting. we need a clear default for private/VPC networking: regional shared gateway with carve-outs or mandatory per-tenant gateways? aim: low ops, predictable egress for most customers, carve-outs for compliance.

ilias: short: shared gateway + carve-outs. we should define the exact carve-out criteria (egress preserve-srcip, dedicated certs, high-throughput). avoid too many carve-outs or we'll re-create per-tenant ops.

mike: agree. important: controlplane contract must include egress_profile and desired_affinity. connectors should advertise canary flags too. minimal schema idea: {version:routing.v1, tenant_id, egress_profile:{preserve_srcip:false|true, reserved_pool:"ent-1"}, affinity:{zone_hint}}
zoe: also need allocator behavior: pre-allocate small IP blocks for slices, but allow operator emergency borrow. telemetry: emit per-tenant egress.ip_changes and allocation_age.

ilias: DNS note: routing-slice controller should push tenant-specific private-records for internal endpoints. make push idempotent via a version stamp per-tenant.

mike: rollback plan: automated route revert if p99 latency regresses beyond threshold, and a nightly reclaim sweep for stale allocations (>72h unused).
eop-bot: rollout notice: routing-slice-controller canary in staging (ci-5124) 

zoe: actions: zoe -> update RFC with carve-out criteria + playbook (Thu); ilias -> define routing.v1 payload + validation rules (Tue); mike -> telemetry + console mock (Wed). reconvene next week.
